in_memory_effects: replace active/current model when IDs match
local_persistence_effects: write current itinerary preference when IDs match
remote_effects: write the current model version without increment or expected-version predicate
remote_predicates: user_id = current authenticated client user ID
tracked_code_impact_boundary.caller_observation: The dialog closes before invocation and an updated-success snackbar is shown without awaiting the Future.
tracked_code_impact_boundary.failure_observation: SharedPreferences and remote failures are log-only; no stable receipt, reconciliation job, caller-visible failure or durable retry is returned.

root_cause_and_effect_chain: The caller does not await the write Future and reports success immediately.
The provider mutates in-memory state and notifies listeners before local or remote persistence completes.
The remote update has no expected-version predicate and writes updatedItinerary.version unchanged.
A concurrent newer row can therefore be overwritten or the UI/local cache can remain changed when the remote mutation fails.
The log-only terminal outcome provides no idempotency identity or stable receipt for deterministic repair.
unknown_count_scope: The count applies only to the selected tracked executable path and its explicit caller. Unavailable production database triggers or external consumers remain unknown production facts and are not represented as absent.
